name: maroto-sealed-component-resource-bundles
instr:
Maroto cannot prepare a document into a sealed, inspectable resource bundle for reproducible rendering after files, byte slices, or code generators become unavailable. Implement this across every generation mode without changing ordinary document behavior.

Every `Component`, including those returned by `code.NewBar`, `image.NewFromBytes`, and `image.NewFromFile`, reports current render resources. Identities stay stable for unchanged content and change with artifact-changing properties. Preparation snapshots immutable file and byte-image content with its selected format, and materializes barcode, matrix, and QR artifacts once in the distinct `ResourceBarcode`, `ResourceMatrixCode`, and `ResourceQRCode` namespaces. Components from `checkbox.New` and `line.New` use no resources and render with an empty sealed bundle.

`ResourceManifest` from `github.com/johnfercher/maroto/v2/pkg/core` deduplicates equivalent resources in deterministic first-layout-occurrence order. `Entries` exposes stable metadata, and `Find` performs kind-and-key lookup. Preparation is atomic. Acquisition failures return no `ResourceBundle` and produce a contextual `ResourceError` identifying the resource and component location. `Manifest` exposes only a completed bundle's manifest.

Bundle-backed generation validates the complete current tree before rendering, rejecting missing, changed, or wrongly typed resources. It replays captured artifacts in sequential, concurrent, and sequential-low-memory generation
